purpose: Eleventh expanded public source layer focused on enzyme cofactor-recycling cascades, late-stage site-selective C-H functionalization, carbohydrate protecting-group and glycosylation strategy, atropisomer and conformational-lock route policy, reactive-metabolite safety critique, prodrug and biologics conjugate linker boundaries, cryo-EM/fragment target-engagement probes, and continuous-flow photochemical/electrochemical process boundaries.

promotion_requirements: explicit precursor structures before template or proposal promotion
separate enzyme-cofactor, site-selective C-H functionalization, carbohydrate-protection, atropisomer, reactive-metabolite, conjugate-linker, target-engagement-probe, or flow-process policy

route-specific cofactor balance, site-selectivity, protecting-group register, anomeric donor class, rotational barrier, metabolite soft spot, linker release mechanism, protein or assay tag, reactor boundary, and process endpoint review

biocatalysis, late-stage-functionalization, glycan-manufacturing, stereochemical, toxicology, biological-mode, conjugate, probe-validation, photochemical, electrochemical, or process-safety review where relevant
safety_scope: records intentionally avoid quantities, operational procedures, and synthesis conditions
enzyme, C-H functionalization, glycan, atropisomer, reactive-metabolite, conjugate-linker, probe, and flow-process entries are high-level route priors only

families.name: Enzyme cascades, redox balance, and cofactor-recycling route motifs
families.strategic_principle: Separate product-forming transformation from cofactor regeneration, redox balance, and enzyme-cascade order. Cofactor recycling is route-defining metadata, not a reagent footnote.

families.name: Late-stage site-selective C-H borylation, halogenation, and functionalization handles
families.strategic_principle: Expose the target C-H site, directing logic, diversification handle, and evidence for site-selectivity. Late-stage functionalization is advisory unless the route records why that position is accessible.

families.name: Carbohydrate protecting-group, donor reactivity, and regioselective glycosylation strategy
families.strategic_principle: Separate monosaccharide identity from protecting-group register, donor reactivity, acceptor position, and glycosylation order. Glycan route logic is register-sensitive metadata.

families.name: Atropisomeric axes, chiral conformers, and conformational-lock medicinal scaffolds
families.strategic_principle: Separate scaffold construction from chiral-axis creation, conformational locking, rotational-barrier control, and stereochemical resolution. Atropisomerism is a route objective, not a passive stereochemical annotation.

families.name: Drug metabolite, reactive-intermediate, and soft-spot safety route critique
families.strategic_principle: Expose metabolic soft spots, bioactivation risks, trapping evidence, and mitigation edits. Metabolite-oriented synthesis supports safety interpretation and must not be scored as ordinary analogue enumeration.

families.name: Prodrug conjugates, cleavable linkers, and biologics-carrier route boundaries
families.strategic_principle: Separate payload, carrier or biologic boundary, linker chemistry, and release mechanism. Conjugate routes are not complete until release policy and carrier identity are explicit.

families.name: Cryo-EM fragments, target-engagement probes, affinity tags, and assay-defining handles
families.strategic_principle: Separate binding fragment, elaboration vector, target-engagement tag, and structural or assay readout. Probe and assay architecture changes precursor acceptance.

families.name: Continuous-flow photochemical and electrochemical route/process boundaries
families.strategic_principle: Separate chemical disconnection from reactor/process boundary, irradiation or electrochemical handle, and scale-up endpoint. Flow photochemistry and electrochemistry are route metadata, not generic conditions.

anchors.name: Biocatalytic cascade with reviewed product-forming enzyme, cofactor loop, and redox balance
Late-stage C-H functionalization handle with reviewed site, substrate class, and selectivity rationale
Carbohydrate route with reviewed protecting-group register, donor reactivity, and glycosylation order
Atropisomeric or conformationally locked scaffold with reviewed axis, barrier, and stereochemical policy
Metabolite or reactive-intermediate critique with reviewed soft spot, trapping evidence, and mitigation edit
Prodrug or conjugate with reviewed payload, carrier boundary, linker, and release mechanism
Fragment or probe series with reviewed binding vector, structural readout, and target-engagement tag
Flow photochemical or electrochemical route with reviewed reactor boundary and process endpoint

disconnections.name: Biocatalytic redox step to product enzyme plus NAD(P)H cofactor-regeneration loop

break_bonds: product-forming redox step to cofactor-regeneration boundary
forward_logic: separate product-forming enzyme choice from cofactor loop design
track redox balance, cofactor identity, and regeneration mode
avoid treating a biocatalytic route as complete without cofactor policy
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward enzyme routes that expose cofactor identity and regeneration logic rather than hiding it as a reagent condition.

evidence.citation: NAD(P)+ regeneration review discusses NAD(P)H oxidase cofactor regeneration for value-added chemicals.
Alcohol dehydrogenase review covers asymmetric synthesis applications relevant to redox biocatalysis.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for explicit enzyme, cofactor, regeneration, and redox-balance metadata

disconnections.name: Cell-free enzyme cascade to platform intermediate plus cofactor and thioester policy

break_bonds: platform intermediate to cascade module boundary
activated thioester to downstream product boundary
forward_logic: separate platform intermediate generation from downstream tailoring
track cofactor, enzyme order, and activated-intermediate stability
keep enzyme cascade records advisory until substrates and enzymes are explicit
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use cascade entries to critique module order and activated-intermediate policy, not to mark pathway intermediates as stock.

evidence.citation: Coenzyme A thioester review discusses platform molecules in cell-free chemical biomanufacturing.
NAD(P)+ regeneration review provides cofactor-loop context for enzyme cascades.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit enzyme order, cofactor loop, and platform-intermediate metadata

disconnections.name: Late-stage C-H functionalization to scaffold plus site-selective borylation/diversification handle

forward_logic: map the functionalized C-H site before scoring retrosynthetic disconnection
separate scaffold synthesis from late-stage handle installation
require site-selectivity rationale before proposal promotion
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward routes that explain why the selected C-H site is addressable and useful as a diversification handle.

evidence.citation: Medicinal chemistry review discusses the emergence of C-H functionalization in drug discovery.
N-heteroarene C-H functionalization review covers recent catalytic advances relevant to medicinal scaffolds.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for explicit C-H site, scaffold class, and selectivity evidence

disconnections.name: Natural-product or complex scaffold to site-selective halogenation/functionalization edit policy

break_bonds: late halogen or edit handle boundary
forward_logic: separate parent scaffold access from late-stage edit
track catalyst or method class only as high-level selectivity metadata
avoid accepting advanced natural-product analogues as stock
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use late-stage edit records for route critique when a parent scaffold and target site are explicit.

evidence.citation: Review discusses nonenzymatic catalysts for alteration of natural products.
Medicinal chemistry C-H functionalization review provides late-stage drug-discovery context.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit parent scaffold, edited site, and selectivity rationale

disconnections.name: Protected carbohydrate to monosaccharide core plus protecting-group register policy

break_bonds: protecting group to hydroxyl register boundary
forward_logic: map hydroxyl register before scoring protecting-group changes
separate monosaccharide identity from orthogonal protection plan
track whether a protected sugar is a route anchor or merely an advanced intermediate
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward glycan routes that preserve protecting-group register and acceptor-position logic.

evidence.citation: Oligosaccharide protecting-group review discusses advances in protecting groups for oligosaccharide synthesis.
Regioselective carbohydrate protection review covers one-pot protection and protection-glycosylation.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for explicit hydroxyl register, donor/acceptor role, and protecting-group plan

disconnections.name: Oligosaccharide to donor/acceptor sequence plus armed-disarmed and one-pot glycosylation policy

forward_logic: separate linkage order from donor and acceptor preparation
track armed-disarmed donor logic and anomeric leaving-group policy
avoid generic glycoside splitting when donor reactivity controls feasibility
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use armed-disarmed metadata to rank glycosylation order and reject register-blind glycan routes.

evidence.citation: Armed-disarmed review covers history, synthesis, and mechanistic studies in carbohydrate chemistry.
Programmable one-pot glycosylation review provides public context for glycosylation sequencing.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for explicit donor/acceptor sequence, anomeric policy, and reactivity hierarchy

disconnections.name: Atropisomeric scaffold to biaryl/axis precursor plus axis-creation or resolution policy

forward_logic: separate scaffold connectivity from axis creation and configurational stability
track whether route uses asymmetric construction, resolution, or barrier tuning
avoid treating atropisomeric targets as achiral biaryl analogues
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward routes that make chiral-axis control explicit rather than scoring only connectivity.

evidence.citation: Atropisomerism review discusses medicinal-chemistry perspective in drug discovery.
Drug-discovery review discusses recent encounters with atropisomerism.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for explicit axis-forming step, barrier, and stereochemical-control metadata

disconnections.name: Conformationally locked scaffold to flexible parent plus rotational-barrier and SAR policy

forward_logic: separate parent pharmacophore from conformational-lock installation
track whether the lock controls potency, selectivity, or stereochemical stability
carry rotational-barrier metadata through route ranking
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use conformational-lock records when geometry and barrier are route objectives, not afterthought annotations.

evidence.citation: Atropisomeric drug-discovery review frames rotational barriers and chiral conformers as medicinal design concerns.
Atropisomerism review provides broader drug-discovery context for restricted-rotation scaffolds.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit lock, parent scaffold, rotational barrier, and SAR role

disconnections.name: Reactive-metabolite liability to parent scaffold plus soft-spot blocking or mitigation edit

forward_logic: separate parent scaffold synthesis from safety-mitigation edits
track structural alert, reactive-intermediate hypothesis, and metabolite evidence
avoid treating safety analogues as ordinary SAR enumeration
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward routes that link analogue changes to explicit reactive-metabolite or soft-spot evidence.

evidence.citation: Reactive-metabolite review discusses managing chemically reactive metabolites in drug development.
Medicinal-chemistry perspective discusses structural alerts and reactive metabolites for toxicity-risk mitigation.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for explicit soft spot, metabolite evidence, and mitigation rationale

disconnections.name: Reactive-intermediate study to trapping adduct/reference standard plus safety-interpretation policy

forward_logic: separate analytical reference synthesis from parent drug route
track trapping reagent role and reactive-intermediate hypothesis
flag all records as safety-critique sources, not proposal generators
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use reactive-adduct entries to support safety critique and reference-standard planning, not to expand synthesis automatically.

evidence.citation: Reactive-metabolite detection review discusses reducing potential drug toxicity.
Early-discovery review covers practical approaches to resolving reactive-metabolite liabilities.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit trapping-adduct, reference-standard, and safety-study metadata

disconnections.name: Drug conjugate to payload plus cleavable linker, carrier, and release mechanism

forward_logic: separate payload synthesis from linker and carrier installation
track release mechanism, biological carrier, and payload exposure policy
avoid generic amide/ester disconnection when release mechanism defines the target
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward conjugate routes that explicitly model payload-linker-carrier roles and release policy.

evidence.citation: Peptide-drug conjugate review discusses research advances in peptide-drug conjugates.
Drug-conjugate linker review summarizes recent advances in linkers of drug conjugates.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for explicit payload, linker, carrier, and release mechanism

disconnections.name: Biologics or disulfide prodrug boundary to payload, protein/peptide carrier, and reducible-release policy

forward_logic: separate small-molecule payload route from biologic or peptide conjugation boundary
track reducible release, carrier identity, and conjugation site
flag biologics boundary entries for modality review
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use biologics-boundary records when the route depends on carrier identity and release mechanism.

evidence.citation: Disulfide prodrug review covers reducible prodrug linkers in cancer-therapy context.
ADC linker-chemistry review provides public conjugation and linker context relevant to biologics boundaries.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit payload, carrier boundary, reducible linker, and conjugation site

disconnections.name: Cryo-EM fragment hit to binding fragment plus elaboration vector and structural-readout policy

forward_logic: separate fragment core synthesis from vector growth and assay tag installation
track structural evidence and target-engagement readout
avoid ranking tagged probes as ordinary SAR analogues
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward fragment routes that preserve the binding vector and structural evidence used to justify elaboration.

evidence.citation: Fragment-based drug-discovery review discusses using cryo-EM for fragment discovery.
Cryo-EM drug-discovery review covers applications and prospects in drug discovery.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit fragment, vector, and structural-readout metadata

disconnections.name: Target-engagement probe to parent ligand plus labelled or affinity tag and validation policy

break_bonds: probe linker to parent ligand boundary
forward_logic: separate parent ligand SAR from tag and linker installation
track target-engagement assay role before route acceptance
flag labelled probes for validation and biological-mode review
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use target-engagement records only when the tag and assay role are explicit.

evidence.citation: Labelled chemical-probe review discusses demonstrating direct target engagement in living systems.
Affinity-based probe review discusses target identification in drug discovery.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for explicit parent ligand, tag, linker, and target-engagement validation metadata

disconnections.name: Photochemical route to substrate/product pair plus continuous-flow reactor and irradiation boundary

forward_logic: separate molecular disconnection from reactor and irradiation constraints
track whether continuous flow changes feasibility, selectivity, or scale-up
avoid treating photochemical flow as a generic condition
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward routes that preserve reactor boundary and photochemical endpoint metadata for process-aware ranking.

evidence.citation: Continuous-flow photochemistry review covers applications in organic synthesis.
Flow photochemistry review discusses flow photochemistry as a tool in organic synthesis.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit photochemical step, reactor boundary, and process endpoint

disconnections.name: Electrochemical or API flow route to substrate/product pair plus cell/reactor process boundary

break_bonds: flow cell or process endpoint boundary
forward_logic: separate molecular redox disconnection from electrochemical cell and flow-process design
track whether the step is route-defining for sustainability, selectivity, or scale-up
flag electrochemical entries for process and electrical-safety review
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use flow-electrochemistry entries to distinguish process-enabling routes from ordinary redox reactions.

risks: electrical and process safety review required

evidence.citation: Flow electrochemistry review discusses bridging laboratory and industry.
API electrochemistry review discusses synthesis of active pharmaceutical ingredients using electrochemical methods.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit electrochemical step, cell/reactor boundary, and API process endpoint

source_notes.summary: The v12 expansion promotes backlog families for cofactor-recycling enzyme cascades, late-stage C-H functionalization, carbohydrate glycosylation strategy, atropisomer/conformational-lock policy, reactive-metabolite safety critique, conjugate linker boundaries, cryo-EM/target-engagement probes, and continuous-flow photochemical/electrochemical process metadata.

Biocatalytic, late-stage-functionalization, glycan, atropisomeric, reactive-metabolite, conjugate-linker, target-engagement-probe, and flow-process records are advisory. Promotion to proposal generation requires explicit chemical, biological, toxicology, process, or validation review as applicable.
